script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: THE GREAT RESET

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JANE (30s, disheveled, wearing a stained apron), stands over an overflowing sink. She looks exhausted. Her husband JASON (40s, wearing a suit and tie) enters.

JASON
(cheerfully)
Morning, dear! I'm off to the office.

JANE
(sarcastically)
Oh joy! I bet that's just what you look forward to every day.

JASON
(pausing)
What's wrong, honey?

JANE
(frustrated)
I can't take this anymore! I'm tired of being a stay-at-home mom. I want to do something for me.

JASON
(surprised)
What do you mean? You love being a mom.

JANE
(defeated)
I do, but I need more than just this. I need a career.

JASON
(proudly)
Well, I've got a great idea! Why don't you start your own business from home? It'll give you the flexibility to be there for the kids and still pursue your dreams.

JANE
(excited)
That's it! I'll make beautiful, handcrafted jewelry. I've always loved making things with my hands.

JASON
(smiling)
I knew you had it in you. I'll help you get started.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jane sets up her makeshift workshop on the coffee table. She spends hours researching and ordering supplies online.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

JASON
(entering)
How's it going, dear?

JANE
(frustrated)
I've ordered all the supplies, but I don't know where to start.

JASON
(encouraging)
You'll figure it out. Just take it one step at a time.

INT. JANE'S STUDIO APARTMENT - DAY

Jane settles into her new workspace, surrounded by beads, strings, and tools. She puts on some music and begins creating her first piece.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jane meets with FRANCESCA (50s, fashionable, confident), a successful businesswoman and mentor.

FRANCESCA
(impressed)
These are lovely, Jane. I'd be happy to help you sell them online.

INT. JANE'S STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jane packages her first order and sends it off to her first customer. She smiles, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

INT. JANE'S HOME - EVENING

Jane, Jason, and the kids (a boy and a girl, aged 5 and 7) gather around the kitchen table to enjoy dinner together.

JANE
(smiling)
I'm so glad I made this change. I'm doing something I love and I'm still here for my family.

JASON
(proud)
That's the spirit!

INT. JANE'S STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jane sits at her table, surrounded by her supplies, working late into the night. She looks content, knowing that she's finally found her calling.

FADE OUT.

THE END

---

This screenplay, "The Great Reset," is a modern comedy about a woman named Jane who is seeking a career transition after years of being a stay-at-home mom. With no guns or violence, the story follows Jane as she starts her own handcrafted jewelry business from home, with the support of her husband and a successful businesswoman mentor. The pacing is realistic, with each scene building on the previous one, leading to Jane's ultimate sense of accomplishment and fulfillment.
